summary.intent: Use the GSD workflow management system to discuss, plan, and execute three bug-fix phases (42: API unpin integrity, 43: FUSE write durability, 44: IPNS conflict handling) as part of milestone v1.1 UAT gap closure for the CipherBox project.
summary.outcome: All three phases were fully discussed, planned, and executed via worktree-isolated parallel agents. Phases 42 and 44 closed completely; Phase 43 passed verification with 4 runtime UAT items flagged for human testing. ROADMAP.md was accidentally truncated by a gap-planning agent and restored from git history.

repo: The unpin endpoint (POST /ipfs/unpin) had no ownership check — any JWT holder with an account (open signup via Web3Auth) could unpin any CID, including other users' content

CIDs are public identifiers: Kubo v0.40 runs with the 'server' profile (docker/docker-compose.staging.yml:62-72) and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly, broadcasting provider records for every pinned CID to the DHT
writable-share saves drop prunedCids without unpinning — there is no legitimate cross-user unpin path in the existing code
BYO-IPFS unpin is broken in both directions today; the guardedUnpin fix handles BYO advisory rows as equal to server rows

pnpm test path filtering breaks with the '--' separator: 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api test -- --testPathPattern=X' has pnpm insert its own '--', causing jest to treat the flag as a positional regex. Use 'pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api exec jest --testPathPattern=X' instead
1Password SSH commit signing requires dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git Bash calls; agent errors ('agent returned an error') require the user to restart 1Password
gsd commit helper returns 'committed: false' as a false negative — always verify with 'git log', never blind-retry
Gap-planning agents can silently truncate ROADMAP.md (658 lines → 25 lines occurred at commit c70affb5c); always verify ROADMAP line count after gap-planner runs
Cross-package dist staleness causes false TypeScript errors: sdk-core and sdk must be rebuilt before typechecking web (tsc checks against dist, not source)
The '.planning/' folder had no .prettierignore protection; prettier mangled markdown tables in VALIDATION.md by treating escaped regex pipes as table column separators

code.finding: The unpin handler never reads req.user; it passed whatever CID string arrives straight to Kubo pin/rm, enabling cross-tenant data destruction with any valid JWT

Kubo v0.40 runs with 'server' profile and swarm port 4001 exposed publicly (tcp+udp). The server profile only disables local-network discovery, keeping full public DHT participation — every pinned CID is advertised to DHT crawlers
Writable-share saves drop prunedCids without calling unpin — confirmed no cross-user unpin in the normal save path

Was receiving ipnsRecord and calling batchPublishIpnsRecords downstream; rewired in Phase 44 to consume the new updateFileMetadata CAS return shape (metadataCid, newSequenceNumber, prunedCids) directly
Had a stray spawn_journal.remove call in the background upload thread that created an orphan window between upload_content success and parent-pointer publish; fixed in Phase 43 gap closure (CR-08)
New pending_unpins table has no userId column by design — the outbox is per-CID, not per-user, matching the refcount semantics

updateFolderMetadataAndPublish now takes baseChildren parameter and implements a 4-attempt backoff+jitter loop on IPNS 409 conflicts, throwing typed ConflictError after exhaustion; also returns publishedChildren (the merged set at point of successful publish) so callers compose from the correct base

workflow: The cleanup-wave helper must run from the repo root, not from inside an agent worktree — running it from a worktree causes false base_mismatch errors because it resolves repoRoot from cwd
cleanup-wave is not idempotent: already-merged entries report branch_mismatch on rerun; write reduced manifests containing only remaining entries rather than rerunning the full original manifest
Before running cleanup-wave, remove node_modules and .husky/_ from agent worktrees — these untracked dirs block the merge
When a worktree merge leaves MERGE_HEAD (all conflicts auto-resolved but commit step failed), run 'git commit --no-edit' to conclude it, then manually remove the worktree and branch
nest build can produce formatting-only diff in openapi.json as a side effect; restore with 'git checkout --' before merging worktrees to avoid spurious conflicts
Decision coverage gates use literal string matching (e.g., 'D-07:') — plan files must cite decision IDs explicitly in must_haves sections, not just implement the behavior
After gap-planning agents run, always check ROADMAP.md line count — truncation to a single phase block is a known failure mode
Always rebuild cross-package dists (sdk-core, sdk) before running TypeScript checks on downstream packages to avoid false errors from stale dist files

friction: 1Password SSH signing failed multiple times across the session requiring app restarts; required dangerouslyDisableSandbox: true on all git commits
gsd commit helper returned 'committed: false' false negatives, wasting retries and causing confusion about whether commits landed
ROADMAP.md was truncated from 658 lines to 25 lines by a gap-planning agent (commit c70affb5c); required git restoration from prior commit
Session limit hit 3 times mid-execution, interrupting worktree merge flows and requiring state reconstruction
Accidental user input ('touring wyatt web bossy') twice during execution interrupted background agent tracking
Planner socket error after writing plans 01-03 for Phase 42 required filesystem fallback and a continuation planner agent
pnpm test path pattern syntax break (pnpm inserts '--' before jest flags) caused test gate failures until workaround discovered
cleanup-wave cwd bug produced false base_mismatch errors, requiring manual diagnosis and rerun from correct directory
cleanup-wave non-idempotency required writing reduced manifests for partial reruns after interruptions
openapi.json formatting drift from nest build side-effect needed manual restoration before wave 3 merge
Cross-package dist staleness caused 8 false TypeScript errors in web after gap-wave merge, requiring rebuild to resolve
zsh multi-glob rm abort: 'rm -rf node_modules apps/*/node_modules' fails entirely if any glob misses — must use single paths
open_items: Phase 43 has 4 runtime UAT items pending human testing: journal persistence across crash, WriteParked tray notification, replay on mount after crash, desktop tray variant display — documented in 43-UAT.md
Security gate: SECURITY.md missing for Phase 42 — /gsd:secure-phase 42 needs to be run
BYO provider.unpin client-side wiring deferred (noted in Phase 42 CONTEXT.md deferred ideas) — server-side BYO handling is correct but the client SDK doesn't call provider.unpin on delete
Writable-share prunedCids leak deferred — shared-write.ts:450 drops prunedCids without unpinning; tracked as known behavior, not fixed in Phase 42
Rust FUSE conflict handling parity deferred (Phase 44 D-09 confirmed: crates/ not updated) — only TypeScript SDK and web layers implement the three-way merge
Pending-uploads UI deferred as future improvement (raised during Phase 43 discussion, noted in CONTEXT.md)
All three phases (42, 43, 44) are on separate feature branches (feat/api-unpin-integrity, feat/fuse-write-durability, feat/ipns-conflict-handling) and have not been merged to main
Pre-existing REQUIREMENTS traceability gap in Phase 44 noted by verifier but classified as pre-existing, not fixed
Drift report (pin ls diff vs pinned_cids) is detect-only by design — no auto-GC, manual review of orphaned pins needed
